newsitem.title: USA: S.C. Housing Authority repriced, top yield raised.
newsitem.headline: S.C. Housing Authority repriced, top yield raised.

text.p: Goldman, Sachs & Co. said Thursday it repriced S.C. State Housing Finance and Development Authority's $30 million bond deal, raising the top yield to 5.967 percent from 5.95 percent.
ALL ORDERS WILL BE CONSIDERED UNTIL 1:30PM.
NO ADDITIONAL ORDERS WILL BE TAKEN.
ALL BONDS ARE PRICED AT PAR.
LEGISLATION HAS BEEN RECENTLY INTRODUCED WHICH WILL

PERMIT THE SOUTH CAROLINA STATE HOUSING FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY TO PROVIDE CREDIT ENHANCEMENTS TO SELECTED ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS LOCATED IN THE STATE. ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND OTHER STATE OFFICIALS HAVE SUGGESTED THAT THE AUTHORITY PROVIDE SUCH AN ENHANCEMENT TO A PROPOSED RETIREMENT VILLAGE WHICH IS TO BE LOCATED IN LANCASTER COUNTY, SOUTH CAROLINA. THE ASSETS BEING REVIEWED TO COLLATERALIZE THIS CREDIT ENHANCEMENT CONSIST OF (i) EXCESS REVENUE AVAILABLE TO THE AUTHORITY UNDER ITS OUTSTANDING SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL RESOLUTIONS (INCLUDING THE GENERAL BOND RESOLUTION); (ii) MONEYS AND INVESTMENTS HELD BY THE AUTHORITY IN FUNDS UNDER ITS VARIOUS RESOLUTIONS (INCLUDING THE GENERAL BOND RESOLUTION) IN EXCESS OF THE AMOUNTS REQUIRED TO BE HELD IN SUCH FUNDS; (iii) MORTGAGE LOANS MADE BY THE AUTHORITY FROM MONEYS OTHER THAN PROCEEDS OF THE SALE OF THE BONDS AND PREPAYMENTS OF MORTGAGE LOANS; AND (iv) ANY OTHER AVAILABLE ASSETS OR FUNDS.
AT THIS TIME THE AUTHORITY CANNOT ASSESS THE ECONOMIC
IMPACT OF THIS PROPOSED LEGISLATION. THE AUTHORITY'S BONDS ARE SPECIAL OBLIGATIONS SECURED BY THE ASSETS PLEDGED UNDER THE RESOLUTIONS AND ARE NOT FULL FAITH AND CREDIT OBLIGATIONS OF THE AUTHORITY.
MOODY'S INVESTORS SERVICE HAS SINCE RECONFIRMED THE

UNDERLYING RATINGS OF THE OFFERED BONDS AT Aa2 AND AMBAC HAS ALSO RECONFIRMED THEIR COMMITMENT TO INSURE THE BONDS. AS A RESULT, THE MORTGAGE REVENUE BONDS, SERIES 1997 WILL BE RATED Aaa/AAA (MOODY'S / S&P).
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
The award is expected Friday, June 6, 1997.
This issue is book entry through DTC.
